definition: The process of identifying and removing duplicate or near-duplicate records from a dataset.
details: Deduplication of training data has been shown to improve language model training efficiency and reduce issues like memorization of specific repeated text, making it a standard preprocessing step for large text corpora.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Boil it down and it is this: The process of identifying and removing duplicate or near-duplicate records from a dataset. Here is why it matters: Deduplication of training data has been shown to improve language model training efficiency and reduce issues like memorization of specific repeated text, making it a standard preprocessing step for large text corpora. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. That care with the raw material is Deduplication.
